name: Scorpion The
overview: The scorpion in Scripture symbolizes both the physical dangers of the desert, where it abounded with a venomous sting causing torment, and spiritual realities such as severe scourges and wicked men. God’s people are reminded of His deliverance from these perils, as seen in the wilderness led by Him through places filled with scorpions (Deuteronomy 8:15). Christ granted His disciples power over scorpions and all the enemy’s power, signifying authority over spiritual adversaries (Luke 10:19). The imagery of scorpions also conveys the harsh chastisement and torment brought by ministers of Antichrist and rebellious hearts (1 Kings 12:11; Ezekiel 2:6).
